title: Louisiana court upholds $50,000 distress award but cuts campsite lost rent payout to $2,250
summary_full: In St Martin Parish, landowners have been granted a $50,000 award for emotional distress stemming from a campsite lease. Despite their initial claim for lost rent amounting to $150,000, the appeals court revised it down to only $2,250. Cleanup costs for the severely damaged property are still under consideration due to a lack of evidence. The court supported the distress compensation and previously awarded legal fees throughout the trial.
